reason: The successful value-free official archive audit established that the executable all-campaign catalog contains exactly 80 actions with item IDs 0 through 79, despite published documentation describing 81 actions 0 through 80.

correction.target_policy_interpretation: The preregistered estimand already defines uniform_random as probability 1/n_actions for every action. Therefore the executable target is uniform over the archived catalog with probability 1/80 per action; the target-policy family is unchanged.
correction.positivity_interpretation: At the full-log catalog level, both BTS and Random observe every archived action, so the 81-to-80 correction is not itself a positivity failure. Position-1 evaluation-window support remains to be audited before OPE.

unchanged: Random reference restricted to BTS evaluation timestamps
outcome_visibility: No click count, CTR, reward mean, OPE estimate, challenger value, policy ranking, or promotion result was inspected to make this correction.
